title: Aevrynd r0030 contour-preserving separated eye optics
originalDescription: Realistic scan data model with multiresolution details
licenseEvidence: r0027 CC0 selected-collection metadata inspection and global Human Base Meshes README; not a license inferred from other demo assets.
modifications: Append only the selected female body and two eyes; no other asset collection, programs, rig or materials.
Preserve raw mesh vertices/topology, UVs and all Multires sculpt details.
Apply one shared uniform height/unit scale and translation to the parent hierarchy; no shape morph or individual eye transform.
Assign own neutral clay and existing own review camera/light/world for geometry comparison.
Remove unused append library identifiers after proving no linked data. Saved model has no external libraries/texts/images/rigs/actions.
Own native inward-wall region extraction seeded by actual crossing faces; fixed actual eyeball support halfspaces.
83 native body vertices moved by minimum halfspace correction, max1.369797mm. Original eye geometry/neutral transforms, base topology/UV and Multires levels remain.
No eye size/position change, remesh, new cover surface or material/lighting alteration.

Split each original CC0 globe into front cornea and posterior sclera along an actual shared source edge loop at the chosen limbus plane. Union envelope retained within recorded numeric residual; no globe shrink or head geometry change.
Add one closed iris annulus with depth/pupil aperture and one recessed open dark backing per eye.
Own iris texture explicitly sRGB-encoded for byte PNG; image and all component meshes saved/packed.
A dark incorrect-encoding study retained as rejected; B color-corrected partial optical layout retained.

GEO-body_female_realistic.comparison: Saved independent source vs fresh official selected CC0 collection under the same shared float32 transform. All evaluated vertices, not samples.

notAuthoredByAevrynd: Original female scan topology/sculpt and eyeball mesh are Dan Ulrich CC0 asset data. This is an adapted source study, not an original character sculpt claim.
limitations: Neutral static only; gaze/blink/continuous motion not tested.
Source cornea contour and single-interface EEVEE refraction are approximate, not calibrated ocular optics.
Wetline/lacrimal tissue and full skin/hair/rig/oral/clothes/runtime still missing.
Pupil backing is a dark interior proxy behind a real iris aperture, not a retinal/lens simulation.
No body self-contact expansion; body geometry is exactly r29 and its existing scoped static evidence remains applicable.
Sampled unsigned gaps/residuals are not exact full-surface signed minima.
newOwnData: Triangle partitioning author code, annular iris/thickness geometry, dark pupil backing, radial iris texture and optical materials are authored locally. No downloaded iris image, eye program or other-engine runtime.
originalCC0Data: Female body, original eye exterior contour and source smooth normals derive from Dan Ulrich CC0 data.

opticalApproximation.approximation: One refracting interface. No aqueous/lens/retinal simulation or physical calibration.

colorWorkflow.scope: Actual saved PNG round-trip, allowing8-bit quantization of both inputs. Not a proof of biological iris color or human similarity.
